entry.title: Compatibility levels in Power BI: what each one unlocks, and what raising it costs
entry.summary: Every semantic model carries a compatibility level. It decides which features the model can use, and raising it is a one-way change. Here is what each level unlocks and what to check before the next raise.

entry.title: SVG visuals in Power BI, built from reusable parts
entry.summary: A DAX measure can return an SVG image: bars, pills and small charts inside a table cell. Write it in named variable sections, then move the parts you repeat into DAX functions.

entry.title: Know your PBIP: what every file in a Power BI project is for
entry.summary: A field guide to the Power BI project folder: what each file holds, which ones an AI agent can safely edit, and which ones must never leave your machine.

entry.title: A candlestick chart in Power BI, no custom visual
entry.summary: Error bars for wicks, a transparent series under the bodies, and measures that stay right on weekly or monthly candles. I packaged the chart as a Claude Code skill and tested it blind against a plain agent session.

entry.title: Actual vs target in Power BI, with the variance in green and red
entry.summary: Power BI has no variance bar, but its error bars can draw one. I packaged the chart as a Claude Code skill and tested it blind against a plain agent session.

entry.title: A Pareto chart for Power BI that survives re-sorting
entry.summary: One visual calculation keeps a Pareto line smooth whatever the axis sort. I packaged the chart as a Claude Code skill and tested it blind against a plain agent session.
